messages:
nick: FYI: we're launching 'Expedited Legal-Hold Export' for Private/VPC tenants next week. Use-case: customers needing signed, redacted bundles for subpoenas or legal holds with an expedited verification flow. Opt-in only, requires signed DPA addendum + legal-approval token. Agent v3.2+ required.

prudence: TL;DR constraints: 60GB per bundle (supports chunked streaming), up to 2 concurrent exports per tenant, rate limit 2 exports/hour. Expedited queue prioritized but still best-effort; emergency SLA available via legal token.

omar: Ops: adding expedited_export_queue metric and a tenant-level emergency pause toggle. We'll also add disk/memory preflight warnings in the upgrade job.

legal: Legal will provide an addendum template and an approval token process. I uploaded draft to /legal/drafts/expedited-legalhold-addendum.md. CS must capture approver identity and reason.

nick: Security: artifacts will be signed with HSM-backed keys and include a manifest with SHA256 checksums and signer metadata. We'll publish public verification key for customers.

helena: Customer API example:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://private-console.redwood.example/api/v1/tenants/ORG/exports?expedite=true" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"since":"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z","redaction_profile":"pii-plus","legal_token":"LT-abc123"}'
```

kate: CS: I'll run three customer office hours and need a short checklist: required addendum, legal token steps, expected windows.

ops-bot: deploy-notice: expedite handlers scheduled for canary 2026-05-20T09:00Z -> 2026-05-20T11:00Z. Auto-rollback at threshold.

omar: Action items: infra to update KMS/HSM policies, ops to add runbook section on abort/retry and reassembly of chunks, cs/legal to finalize approval flow. Please ack when done.

nick: No change to inference SLOs. Exports run on control-plane resources and should not affect token-generation latency.

prudence: Ack. I'll coordinate the legal token onboarding doc.
